footnote: The author's local Jev-compatible server in its default full configuration: a frozen Qwen3.5-9B scores each option by its mean log-probability (one forward pass per option, no generation, no decision training). Run serially on our GPU. It re-reads the state once per option; if its reported token count covers one pass only, a per-token hosted price would be higher than this estimate.
